name: Piyona Pikona
source:
Main character is a prince of a kingdom, but he is branded ineligible for succession because of magic affinity. He enters "Magical High School" to prove his worth, but decides to rather get himself a harem from girl students and teachers.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一個王國的王子，卻因為對魔法有著特殊的親和力，被認為沒有王位繼承資格。他進入「魔法高中」是為了證明自己的價值，後來卻改變心意，決定把女學生和女老師全納入自己的後宮。

[出自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
